items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: Else McKinley, The Flamingos, and the El Dorados, and the Moonglows, all these people I’ve recorded with and worked with.

ctx.x: Yeah, Albert Collins and Albert King, and all these blues players I used to work with years ago. Else McKinley, The Flamingos, and the El Dorados, and the Moonglows, all these people I’ve recorded with and worked with. So you get, you have a feeling for it.
Did you find it different to work with British blues musicians?
